 Introduction 
 Patrick 
My guest today is Matt Mullenweg, co-founder and CEO of Automatic, the company on top of the open source project WordPress that Matt helped start. Today, WordPress powers, 40% of all websites in the world. Our wide-ranging conversation covers the state of the internet when Matt first started WordPress, the symbiotic relationship between open source and proprietary projects, and how the most successful companies are really master world builders.
